notes: Synthetic ChArUco test photos with known ground truth: box X(width)=120, Y(depth)=80, Z(height)=90 mm. Board = shipped A4 ChArUco (DICT_5X5_1000, 7x11, 24mm square). Inputs in dim-diagram-workspace/inputs/.

evals.name: three-view-dimensioned-drawing
evals.prompt: I photographed a part from three angles - front.png, top.png, and side.png - and each photo has a printed ChArUco board placed next to the part for scale. Produce a CAD-style 3-view dimensioned drawing (front/top/side) with the part's real-world dimensions in millimetres, and tell me the overall length, width, and height.
evals.expected_output: A 3-view dimensioned drawing (SVG/PDF/DXF) plus reported overall dims ~ width 120, depth 80, height 90 mm (within ~2%), with cross-view consistency.

evals.name: single-view-measurement
evals.prompt: Here's a single photo (front.png) of an object sitting next to a printed ChArUco board. How wide and how tall is the object in millimetres? Show your reasoning about scale.
evals.expected_output: Width ~120 mm and height ~90 mm (within ~2%), scale derived from the ChArUco board (not guessed).

evals.name: make-board-and-capture-advice
evals.prompt: I want to measure my robot's dimensions from phone photos as accurately as possible. Give me a printable scale-reference board to use, and tell me exactly how to position it and shoot the photos to get the best accuracy.
evals.expected_output: Generates/points to a printable ChArUco board (A4) and gives capture guidance: board coplanar & beside the object (per-view orientation), shoot far with long lens, square-on, verify print scale, target ~1-2%.
